name: Ooze | Pronto
description:
The Ooze Pronto electronic concentrate vaporizer is incredibly easy to use, and can be enjoyed by both new users and longtime dabbers. New users will love how straightforward it is to set up and use. Simply charge it up and click the button five times to turn it on. Seasoned users will fall in love with the portability of this device, and the lack of cleanup it requires.

Small enough to fit in a pocket or bag, the Pronto can go just about anywhere. This device makes it easy to experiment with different temperature levels. This is ideal because the different terpenes in the concentrate produce flavors at different temperatures. Since each strain has a different mix of terpenes, it will take a little trial and error to find that perfect heat level for each new strain.

PRONTO | The Ooze Pronto is a handheld electric dab straw device for concentrates. Eliminate the mess from handling sticky wax and use a nectar collector device with a reliable battery for on the go use.
RAPID CHARGE | The Ooze Pronto includes a USB-C charger. This device has rapid charging, and the battery is reliable, staying charged for hours while out of the house.
FLEX TEMP | The Pronto has flex temp, which means it has 3 different temperature levels to choose from. Click the button three times to change the level; each level pairs well with certain terpenes for flavor enhancement.
COLORS | The Pronto is available in 4 color options. Black, chrome, gold, and rainbow all have a metallic finish that reflects with the geometric shape of the device.
FLAVOR | The Pronto was designed to enhance the natural flavor of terpenes. We recommend trying all 3 temperature levels every time a new strain is brought home. Different terps taste stronger at different temperatures, so experiment to find the sweet spot.
